name: Sakura no Kioku
source:
Returning the forgotten memories— an Omegaverse mother and daughter yuri story.

One day, when I woke up, I was alone.
The happiness I thought would last forever ended far too soon.
The phone call that came on an early Autumn day was the first crack.
Later, it would end up spelling out the loss of everything.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01203767.html]DLsite[/url]]
